buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 5. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses List of Mandatory Documents to be Uploaded for Technical Evaluation The bidders shall upload the following documents along with their technical bid for evaluation: 1. 1. MSME Certificate: Copy of valid Udyam/MSME Registration Certificate in the relevant category, wherever applicable. Bidders claiming MSE benefits shall submit valid supporting documents. 2. 2. OEM Authorization / Experience Certificate: Copy of OEM Certificate / Authorized Distributor Certificate / Authorized Dealer Certificate. Alternatively, documentary proof of experience in Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning (SITC) of RO/Water Purifiers in Central Government Depart ments / State Government Departments / PSUs / CPSEs or other Government organisations shall be submitted. 3. 3. PAN Card: Copy of valid PAN Card of the bidder/firm. 4. 4. GST Registration: Copy of valid GST Registration Certificate. 5. 5. Undertaking for Tribal Pass: An undertaking confirming that the successful bidder shall obtain the necessary Tribal Pass/entry permissions for its service engineers, technicians and installation pe rsonnel for carrying out installation and commissioning at both Campbell Bay and Kamorta, whereve r required, at its own cost. ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of RO Water Purification Systems at C ampbell Bay and Kamorta, Nicobar District 1. Tribal Pass / Entry Permission: The successful bidder/agency shall be solely responsible for obtaining the necessary Tribal Pass, e ntry permits and other statutory permissions from the competent authorities for its service engine ers, technicians, installation personnel and other representatives required to visit Campbell Bay and Kamorta for carrying out installation, testing and commissioning of the RO Water Purification Systems. 2. Responsibility for Documentation: The agency shall arrange and submit all necessary documents, identity proofs, photographs and ot

her particulars as required by the competent authorities for obtaining Tribal Pass/entry permission for both locations. The agency shall ensure that the requisite permissions are obtained well in adva nce of the proposed visit. 3. Cost of Tribal Pass and Logistics: All expenses towards obtaining necessary permissions, documentation, travel, transportation, boar ding, lodging and other incidental expenses of the installation team for both Campbell Bay and Ka morta shall be borne entirely by the agency and shall be deemed to be included in the quoted bid price. No additional payment on this account shall be entertained by the Department. 4. Installation and Commissioning: The agency shall ensure successful installation, testing and commissioning of all RO Water Purifica tion Systems at the designated locations at Campbell Bay and Kamorta as per the technical specifi cations and terms of the GeM Bid. The agency shall coordinate with the consignee/Engineer-in-Cha rge before scheduling installation at each location. 5. Compliance with Local Regulations: The agency and its personnel shall strictly comply with all applicable rules, regulations and instruct ions issued by the District Administration, Tribal Welfare authorities and other competent authoriti es governing entry into and movement within Campbell Bay, Kamorta and other restricted areas. 6. Responsibility for Delay: The agency shall initiate the process of obtaining the necessary Tribal Pass and entry permissions i mmediately after award of the contract. Any delay arising due to failure on the part of the agency t o apply for or arrange the requisite permissions in time shall be treated as the responsibility of the agency, and no additional financial claim or extension of delivery period on this ground shall ordina rily be entertained. 7. Entry Without Valid Permission: The agency shall not deploy any personnel or undertake installation activities at Campbell Bay or K amorta without obtaining valid Tribal Pass/entry permission wherever required from the competen t authority. The Department shall not be responsible for any consequences arising out of non-comp liance with applicable entry regulations. 8. Completion of Installation: The supply, installation, testing and commissioning at both Campbell Bay and Kamorta shall be co mpleted within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM contract. The agency shall ensure that all four units are installed and commissioned successfully at their respective designated locations. 9. No Extra Payment: No additional payment shall be admissible towards Tribal Pass, transportation, inter-island movem ent, boarding, lodging, labour or any other incidental expenses required for completing the installa tion and commissioning at both locations. All such costs shall be included in the quoted bid price. Executive Engineer (K&GN) .
